card.name: Sublingual and dissolving tablet wording
card.fires_on: The word 'to' or 'is' just before 'dissolve' or 'disintegrate' in directions for tablets placed on or under the tongue. It also fires on the 'ling' inside 'sublingual'.

modes.label: Before dissolve
modes.description: A small word right before 'dissolve', 'disintegrate' or 'dissolved' in tablet-in-mouth directions.
modes.example: Place tablet directly on the tongue and allow it<< to>> dissolve before swallowing.

modes.label: Inside sublingual
modes.description: The 'ling' part of 'sublingual' or 'sublingually' in dosing and study text.
modes.example: 5 mg sub<<ling>>ually twice daily 5 mg sub

card.plain: It lights up where a tablet is meant to melt in the mouth, just before the word dissolve, and inside the word sublingual.
